historical_record.description: Under the 1947 recreation bond program the Recreation and Park Commission engaged C. F. Strothoff, architect, to design improvements to Margaret S. Hayward Playground ($100,000) and bleachers ($50,000).

The Recreation and Park Commission awarded the contract for improvements to Margaret Hayward Playground to Martinelli Construction Co. at $283,973, the second-lowest bid, rejecting the low bid because its proposal form had been altered.
